reason: A user-interface enhancement that adds an interactive animated whale-girl desktop pet overlay reflecting DeepSeek Harness session states and offering local display controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加可交互的鲸鱼女孩桌面宠物，并根据会话状态显示动画与隐私友好的活动摘要。
summaries.en: Adds an interactive whale-girl desktop pet overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that reflects session states and shows privacy-conscious activity summaries.

capabilities: Displays an animated overlay pet in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Reads current-session status and provider-declared presentation metadata
Provides drag, keyboard movement, collapse, restore, and position reset interactions
Stores user preferences in browser-local storage
